sources: https://barbourvilletourism.com/thompson-r-v-park/ (stored URL redirects here; read 2026-11-24): 'Thompson RV Park is located on Hwy 11 South, alongside the Cumberland River and is open year round. A five minute walk from the Court Square in downtown Barbourville, Thompson Park has all the amenities — playgrounds, a walking track with fitness equipment, covered shelters and a boat ramp for access to the river. For reservations, call 606-627-9232.'

https://cityofbarbourville.com/parks-and-rec/ (read 2026-11-24): 'Thompson Park RV contact numbers: For reservations and information contact RV Host ... at (606) 546-3784; Address: 125 Old South Main Street'; links 'Thompson RV Park Rates' and 'Thompson RV Park Regulations'

https://cityofbarbourville.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/ThompsoRVParkRates2022.pdf (read 2026-11-24): 'RATES FOR THOMPSON RV PARK 2022 ... Nightly Rates: Concrete $25.00, Grass/Gravel $20.00; Monthly Rates: Concrete $400.00, Grass/Gravel $280.00 months of Apr-Oct, $400.00 months of Nov-Mar; Weekly Rates: Concrete $125.00, Grass/Gravel $100.00. A 10% discount will be given to all Veterans ... A 6% sales tax applies to any camper staying less than thirty (30) continuous days ... A $50.00 deposit is required at the time of booking for all holidays and special events with the full balance paid 14 days (2 weeks) prior to arrival.'

https://cityofbarbourville.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/ThompsonRVparkRegulations2022.pdf (read 2026-11-24): 'Park Spaces are rented on a 24-hour basis (Day to Day Tenancy)'; check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon; 'Two vehicles only per campsite'; 'NO four wheelers, golf carts or off-road vehicles allowed in park'

Google Maps (headless browser) 2026-11-24: 'Thompson Park and RV Camping', 4.5 from 290 reviews, 603 S Main St, +1 606-546-3784; recent reviews describe a clean park, playground, splash pad, dog park, 'nice rock area to hang out at beside the river'

Esri World_Imagery 36.8597,-83.8884 hw 200, viewed 2026-11-24: some 40-45 rigs packed along the paved RV lot inside the river bend; the Cumberland River lies ~90-120 m W/NW of the pads beyond a continuous wooded bank

values.note: From the city's 2022 rate sheet, still the one the city links: concrete sites $25, grass/gravel $20; weekly and monthly rates offered. 6% sales tax on stays under 30 days; veterans 10% off.
Reservations through the RV host by phone. A $50 deposit is due at booking for holidays and special events, refundable only if the host rebooks the site.

note: City of Barbourville park in Thompson Park beside the Cumberland River, a five-minute walk from the courthouse square: playgrounds, a splash pad, a walking track, a dog park, covered shelters and a boat ramp. --Claude
summary: Confirmed year-round, phone booking; new: rates $20 grass/gravel / $25 concrete from the city's 2022 sheet (still the linked one), holiday deposit. Not waterfront holds. 50A/35 sites/45 ft not on any operator page - left as derived.
flags: PHONE: 606-627-9232 -> 606-546-3784 (the city Parks and Rec page names this as the RV host's reservations number; Google agrees). The tourism page still prints 606-627-9232.

WEBSITE: https://www.barbourvilletourism.com/adventure/thompson-r-v-park redirects to https://barbourvilletourism.com/thompson-r-v-park/ -> suggest https://cityofbarbourville.com/parks-and-rec/ (the operator's own page with the rate sheet and rules) first, tourism page second.
RATES ARE THE CITY'S 2022 SHEET: no newer sheet is linked. A 2018 Google review reported $25.25 with tax for full hookups, so the sheet looks current-ish, but a rate rise since 2022 is possible.

HOOKUPS/SITES UNCONFIRMED: electric 50, count 35 and max 45 ft came from note prose (aggregator-sourced); no city page states hookups, a site count or lengths. Left as derived. A 2018 Google review says 'Full hook ups'.

LONG STAY: imagery shows ~40-45 rigs packed onto the lot, and the city sells weekly and monthly rates (monthly $280-$400). Many sites look long-term; nightly share not measurable from public pages. City-owned, so no private long-stay rule applied; the regulations still rent 'Day to Day'.
WATERFRONT not waterfront: HOLDS. The river is ~90-120 m from the pads behind a continuous wooded bank (imagery); a review mentions a rock area 'beside the river', i.e. a walk, not riverside sites.
GOOGLE 4.5 from 290 reviews ('Thompson Park and RV Camping').
PIN 36.8597,-83.8884 sits on the RV lot (Google's pin 36.85939,-83.88838 is ~35 m off) - fine.
OHV: regulations bar four-wheelers and off-road vehicles - not an OHV base.
